placements.why: Establishes the top-level organizational strategy tier for resilience, recovery strategies, and operational verification.
placements.title: Operational Resilience and Recovery Verification
placements.frame: How does the organization structure, maintain, and verify recovery mechanisms and operational resilience?

placements.title: Rollback Capability Demands Continuous Rehearsal
placements.frame: How are rollback and recovery procedures transformed from theoretical plans into verified operational capabilities through recurring practice?
placements.why: Quinton mandates monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals under the explicit principle that an unrehearsed rollback does not constitute a real capability.
